module: System notes in English (co-driver announcements that do not come from corners): start countdown (five to go), time warnings (60, 30, 15, 10 seconds), intercom and belts check, new start minute, false start. The file returns the result of systemPacenotes.localized(...) (module notebook/systemPacenotes) from a table name -> text or list of variants {text, weight}.
notes: File WARNING: any change to a string requires regenerating the audio files.
'precountdown' has two weighted variants: 'Good luck!' (weight 0.5) and 'Best of luck!' (weight 0.1).

Defined names: precountdown, countdown5 to countdown1, countdowngo, warningSeconds60/30/15/10, commsCheck, beltsCheck, rescheduled, falseStart. They are validated by styleValidator via systemPacenotes.validate.
